name: Amano Saya
source:
A cool papa-like sister.

The second daughter of the Amano family and a father figure to the protagonist. A cool and somewhat strict person but she is actually quite delicate. She is no good at house work, instead she is in charge of the protagonist's education and while she doesn't pamper him normally she will do so as a reward.
